createEscrow.termsHelp: Define the financial terms and deadlines for this agreement.

createEscrow.milestonesHelp: Break the escrow into milestones. Each milestone amount will be released when its condition is met.

createEscrow.conditionsHelp: Define the conditions that must be met before funds are released. Leave empty for a fully manual escrow.
createEscrow.noConditions: No conditions added. Funds will be released manually by the parties.
createEscrow.manualCondition: Manual — a party manually confirms completion
createEscrow.timeCondition: Time-based — releases after a specific date/time
createEscrow.oracleCondition: Oracle — an external oracle signals completion
createEscrow.reviewHelp: Please review the details below carefully before creating the escrow.
createEscrow.reviewWarning: Once deployed on-chain, some parameters cannot be changed. Ensure the counterparty address is correct.
